amendments.reason: O usuario retirou toda a maquinaria de worktree: copiar ambiente para dentro de um worktree e maquina demais para o que se pediu. O criterio inverte de sentido e passa a ser catraca contra a reintroducao.
amendments.superseded_statement: when a project declares a `carry` path and a worktree is cut, then that path exists inside the worktree as a real copy.
amendments.statement: when a worktree is cut, then it receives only what git and its submodules bring, and the harness adds nothing of its own

amendments.reason: A junction que o verbo link plantava e seguida por git worktree remove no Windows, que apaga o conteudo do diretorio ligado no checkout PRINCIPAL: reproduzido com e sem --force. O verbo sai e o criterio vira catraca contra a reintroducao.
amendments.superseded_statement: when a project declares a `link` path, then the worktree reaches the main checkout's copy instead of duplicating it.
amendments.statement: when a worktree is cut, then it holds no link of any kind reaching back into the main checkout

amendments.reason: Nada mais viaja para dentro de um worktree, entao nao ha o que reportar como nao viajado. O aviso que o usuario pediu passa a ser o da recusa: ela precisa dizer QUAIS arquivos estao com trabalho nao salvo.
amendments.superseded_statement: when a declared path cannot travel, then the creation still succeeds and the report names that path.
amendments.statement: when the harness refuses to start a second unit, then the refusal names the paths that hold uncommitted work

amendments.reason: A segunda unidade deixa de ganhar worktree e passa a ser recusada. O resultado observavel e o mesmo que importava: o checkout de quem ja estava trabalhando nao e tocado.
amendments.superseded_statement: when the checkout already holds a different unit's branch, then the new unit is cut into its own worktree and the checkout is left untouched.
amendments.statement: when the checkout already holds a different unit branch carrying uncommitted work, then the new unit is refused and the checkout is left untouched

amendments.reason: A prosa ensinava a declarar carry/link e o desvio para worktree, que deixam de existir. Passa a ensinar a recusa e o coletor de orfaos.
amendments.superseded_statement: when the operator prose describes isolation, then it teaches the declared environment and the second-unit rule.
amendments.statement: when the operator prose describes what happens with a second unit, then it teaches the refusal and the orphan collector, and mentions no environment declaration

additions.reason: A revisao provou que a verificacao vive so no hook de escrita, enquanto quem realmente troca de branch e cut_pending_work_branch, chamado por spec-draft antes de qualquer escrita. Sem criterio nesse ponto, a protecao continua sendo testada onde ela nao decide nada.
additions.statement: when spec-draft cuts a unit branch and the checkout already holds another unit uncommitted work, then the cut itself refuses instead of checking out
